items.summary: Implement a backend predictor method in `backend/main.mo` that accepts the user’s percentile input, converts it to an estimated rank, and returns dummy/sample prediction results with fields `college`, `branch`, and `chance` (values like Dream/Probable/Safe).

Wire the existing `frontend/src/pages/MhtCetPredictorFormPage.tsx` submit action to call the backend predictor method using the existing `useActor` hook, and render the returned results in the UI after submission.

Ensure the frontend can call the new backend method by updating the generated frontend backend bindings/types (the `backendInterface` used by `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`) to include the predictor method signature and response types.
